correctness.rationale: The exact matrix identity and compactness are immediate. Singular values of finite constant-weight strict triangular blocks reduce exactly to a first-difference Jacobi matrix. A dyadic S_p tail estimate valid for 1/2<p<1 and rank-one block interactions justify the limit from central geometric blocks, giving the continuous angular counting density. The beta integral yields the stated constant and monotone inversion gives the n^{-2} coefficient; convergence of logarithmic means establishes every Dixmier-trace value.
